name: David M.
quote: Very happy with this product. Excellent epoxy to use for covering art! I've used more expensive brands for many years and I found this one which is more affordable when trying new techniques. Very easy to use.

name: Janet
quote: Hands down the best! I usually use epoxy resin but I decided to try something new! This uv resin is easy to use with no mixing required! The value price is perfect also. Curing time is fast depending on your mold thickness! I am very satisfied with this product and I will be buying more soon!

name: Simon
quote: It is 'very' strong... It has a very smooth surface and high detail. Something really nice with this material is that even if it's very strong it's still easy to sand and carve.

name: Eli
quote: Really easy plaster to help create different figurines with different molds... Great plaster for crafts and molds! It mixes smoothly, dries quickly, and creates strong, detailed pieces. Perfect for making plaster figurines and kids' painting kits.

name: Ramona
quote: I am just beginning to learn about resin jewelry. This product is easy to use. I had used the epoxy and found this is much easier because you don't have to mix. I did not have air bubbles. Dries very clear. Much easier to add color. Cures quickly with UV light. Clean up was quick and easy. I am very pleased. Highly recommend this product.
